summary: Wearable Devices Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a warrant inducement transaction. The company entered into an inducement letter with a holder to exercise existing warrants for cash at a reduced exercise price of $1.73 per share, generating $5.0 million gross proceeds. In exchange, the company issued new warrants to purchase up to 5,082,873 shares at $1.51 per share, exercisable immediately for five years. The transaction closed on April 21, 2026. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners acted as financial advisor for an 8.0% cash fee. Proceeds will be used for working capital. This is a capital raise, not a special situation.
